source.title: Superior Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
source.description:
Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of power?

I must warn you; purchases made at a friendly reputation with the Dawn come with a hefty surcharge. I would advise that you gain a better reputation with the Dawn before moving forward with your plans.
source.objective: For 30 Insignias of the Dawn and 30 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
source.progress: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.
source.completion: Good day, <name>. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
